acceptance: Seismic design report approved; site-specific hazard study delivered
section: ER-02 Site conditions and design data
text: The Site is in a high seismic hazard region. Structures and equipment shall be designed per the Turkish Building Earthquake Code (TBDY 2018) with a site-specific hazard study; design earthquake DD-2 (475-year) peak ground acceleration 0.45 g; building importance factor 1.5 for power block structures; functional recovery of critical systems after DD-3 events.
title: Seismic design
